name: Toleration
overview: Scripture teaches that toleration involves recognizing the diversity of religious practices while maintaining faithfulness to the Lord. Micah 4:4-5 highlights a peaceful coexistence where each person walks in the name of their god, yet believers remain steadfast in serving the LORD. Jesus instructs His followers not to forbid others who perform miracles in His name, even if they do not follow with the same group, emphasizing in Mark 9:38-40 that those not opposing Christ are effectively on His side. This approach calls for discernment and grace in religious toleration without compromising devotion to God.
